rows.grounds: fused sandhi form; internal ācāra-varjanāt + devi

items.question: What happens to a kaulika who abandons conduct?
premises: Abandoning conduct makes a kaulika fallen.
items.inference: A kaulika who abandons conduct becomes fallen.
uncertainties: The fused first token combines conduct-abandonment with the goddess address.
items.plain_english: O goddess, by abandoning conduct a kaulika becomes fallen.
